source_semantics.predicate: GetActivities reads immutable execution activity joined through its job; the owner-scoped overload requires a non-empty owner identity and returns only activity whose job OwnerUserId equals that owner.
source_semantics.ordering: Activities are returned newest first by CreatedAtUtc descending.
source_semantics.take: The requested row count is clamped to the inclusive range 1..1000 before the read.
source_semantics.mutation: The operation is read-only and does not advance, cancel, retry, fabricate, or otherwise mutate execution or activity state.

laravel_adaptation.ledger_mapping: Laravel already persists control-plane activity in operation_logs and approved/external execution activity in immutable audit_events. The adapter composes those existing activity stores rather than introducing duplicate persistence.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_owner_scope: Control-plane logs must join an operation_executions row constrained to both active TenantContext and requested_by_user_id. Approved/external audit events are admitted only after resolving active-tenant executions whose actor_user_id is the supplied owner, so a forged event actor cannot grant access to another owner's job.
laravel_adaptation.ordering_take: The composed activity is sorted by occurred_at descending with deterministic tie breaking and sliced only after take is clamped to 1..1000.
laravel_adaptation.data_boundary: Only execution activity metadata is projected. Credential-like assignments in log/audit messages are redacted before leaving the adapter; operation payload/result and arbitrary audit metadata are not returned.
laravel_adaptation.read_only: No execution, log, audit, approval, or other state is written by getActivities.

proofs: existing Laravel activity stores are composed without creating duplicate persistence
activity is readable only through an active-tenant job owned by the supplied user
cross-tenant rows, same-tenant other-owner rows, and forged-actor audit rows are absent
results are deterministically newest first across activity stores
take is clamped fail-safe to the canonical 1..1000 range
credential-like message assignments are redacted and arbitrary payload/metadata is not exposed
the read creates no audit, log, or execution mutations
invalid owner identity is rejected before lookup and missing TenantContext fails closed
acceptance.external_runtime: No live WordPress/provider/email/payment/DNS/production/manual evidence is required because GetActivities is a tenant-local immutable execution-activity read.
